opportunities.title: Improve Google rating through service quality
opportunities.evidenceSummary: Average rating compared with local competitors on Google Places.
opportunities.whyItMatters: Rating influences patient choice in local pharmacy searches.
opportunities.recommendedAction: Address recurring feedback themes and follow up with recent reviewers where appropriate.
opportunities.expectedBenefit: Stronger reputation signal in local search results.

opportunities.title: Add more Google Business photos
opportunities.evidenceSummary: Photo count compared with local competitors on Google Places.
opportunities.whyItMatters: Photos help patients recognise your pharmacy and improve profile engagement.
opportunities.recommendedAction: Upload professional photos of the pharmacy, team and services to Google Business Profile.
opportunities.expectedBenefit: Stronger first impression and improved local profile completeness.

opportunities.title: Expand Google Business categories
opportunities.evidenceSummary: Category count compared with local competitors on Google Places.
opportunities.whyItMatters: Additional relevant categories help Google match your pharmacy to more local searches.
opportunities.recommendedAction: Review and add optional pharmacy service categories supported by your profile.
opportunities.expectedBenefit: Broader local relevance for pharmacy-related searches.
